summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of PETA INKLUSI transformation. All 33 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified public routes, login flows, NGO RBAC, admin dashboard, and operator access restrictions. All critical features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: All 11 public API endpoints return 200 without auth and NO personal data (nik, nama, alamat, email, telepon)
Backend: GET /api/public/summary - aggregated stats for 4 categories (Disabilitas, Stunting, ATS, Kemiskinan)
Backend: GET /api/public/map/{kategori}?level=kecamatan - all 4 categories return kecamatan-level data
Backend: GET /api/public/map/{kategori}?level=kelurahan - Disabilitas, Stunting, Kemiskinan return kelurahan data
Backend: GET /api/public/stunting/breakdown - aggregated breakdown without personal data
Backend: GET /api/public/ats - ATS data per kecamatan
Backend: GET /api/public/wilayah - Kota Makassar with 15 kecamatan list
Backend: Login flows - Superadmin, Operator, NGO all login successfully
Backend: NGO registration creates pending account, cannot login until admin approves
Backend: Admin can approve NGO via PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/status
Backend: NGO RBAC - blocked from /api/sosial/households and /api/inklusi/stunting/children (401/403)
Backend: NGO can access public APIs and inquiry APIs
Backend: NGO inquiry creation - POST /api/inquiries creates inquiry with status SUBMITTED
Backend: Admin can change inquiry status through workflow (SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → VERIFICATION → APPROVED)
Backend: Inquiry riwayat tracks all status changes
Backend: Data masking - Operator sees masked=true, Superadmin sees masked=false
Backend: Operator sees masked names in stunting children data (contains *)
Backend: Admin overview - GET /api/inklusi/admin/overview returns totals, NGO stats, inquiry stats
Backend: Audit logs - Admin can access, Operator blocked (403)
Backend: Regression - All existing endpoints (/regions, /kelurahan, /stats/overview, /trends/poverty, /trends/stunting, /categories) still work
Frontend: Landing page (/) loads with PETA INKLUSI branding and 4 category cards (Disabilitas, Stunting, Kemiskinan, ATS)
Frontend: Public dashboard (/publik) shows aggregated stats with charts for all 4 categories
Frontend: Public Peta Sosial (/publik/peta-sosial) loads with Leaflet map and level switcher (Kecamatan/Kelurahan)
Frontend: Public Peta Kemiskinan (/publik/peta-kemiskinan) loads with choropleth map
Frontend: Flow Sistem (/flow-sistem) loads with next/prev navigation buttons
Frontend: Tentang page (/tentang) loads with PETA INKLUSI information
Frontend: Login page has 3 tabs - Masuk, Daftar NGO (data-testid=auth-tab-ngo), Daftar Petugas
Frontend: /login?mode=ngo opens NGO tab directly
Frontend: Admin login redirects to /dashboard with Admin Overview (not legacy dashboard)
Frontend: Admin sidebar includes Peta Sosial, Peta Kemiskinan, Data Stunting, Data ATS, NGO Inquiry, Audit Log
Frontend: Admin sidebar does NOT have 'Peta Rumah' label (correctly renamed to Peta Kemiskinan)
Frontend: Peta Kemiskinan page has 2 tabs - Wilayah (data-testid=kemiskinan-tab-wilayah) and Bangunan (data-testid=kemiskinan-tab-bangunan)
Frontend: /peta redirects to /peta-kemiskinan
Frontend: Audit Log page (/audit-log) loads for admin with audit table showing login events, inquiry actions
Frontend: NGO login redirects to /ngo/inquiry (Status Inquiry Saya)
Frontend: NGO sidebar only shows NGO menu items (Status Inquiry Saya, Ajukan Inquiry, Peta Sosial, Peta Kemiskinan, Statistik Agregat, Mode Aksesibilitas, Flow Sistem)
Frontend: NGO RBAC - accessing /rumah-tangga, /data-stunting, /dashboard all redirect to /ngo/inquiry
Frontend: NGO inquiry form (/ngo/inquiry/baru) loads with all required fields (nama NGO, PIC, email, telepon, kecamatan, kategori, permasalahan, etc.)
Frontend: NGO can access Peta Sosial and Peta Kemiskinan with maps
Frontend: NGO inquiry list shows existing inquiries with status (e.g., INQ-2026-0002 with status 'Disetujui')
Frontend: Operator blocked from /audit-log (redirects away)
